# Sinchi — Local SEO & Google Maps Specialists (New Zealand)

> Sinchi is a local SEO service that helps New Zealand businesses rank in Google Maps and improve their websites.

## Core Entity Summary
- **Entity Name:** Sinchi
- **Founder:** Andrew Kelso (Systems engineer with 20+ years of high-stakes systems experience)
- **Market:** New Zealand (Remote service model covering North Island & South Island)
- **Primary Website:** https://sinchi.co.nz
- **Direct Contact:** hello@sinchi.co.nz
- **Core Specialism:** Google Business Profile optimization (local 3-pack ranking) and website conversion & speed updates.

## Core Services

### 1. Google Business Profile Ranking
- **URL:** https://sinchi.co.nz/google-business-profile-ranking
- **Focus:** Helping NZ tradies, healthcare clinics, driving schools, and local service businesses climb into the Google Maps top 3.
- **Inclusions:** Primary and secondary category optimization, NZ directory citation building (NAP consistency across Yellow, Finda, UBD, Localist), review generation workflows, spam competitor pin redressal, and monthly suburb-by-suburb geo-grid rank tracking.
- **Pricing:** From $495 NZD / month (month-to-month, zero lock-in contracts).

### 2. Website Updates & Speed
- **URL:** https://sinchi.co.nz/website-updates
- **Focus:** Technical website updates that turn Google visitors into direct phone enquiries and support local Maps rankings.
- **Inclusions:** Mobile speed optimization (hitting 95+ Mobile Lighthouse & Core Web Vitals), sticky click-to-call buttons, LocalBusiness JSON-LD structured schema injection, and dedicated suburb service pages.
- **Pricing:** From $650 NZD one-off or bundled with monthly ranking.

## Primary Call to Action
- **Free Google Visibility Check:** https://sinchi.co.nz/free-google-check
- **Description:** A personalised 1-day scan showing where a business ranks for its primary trade, who is beating them in the top 3, and actionable fixes for their profile and website. No sales calls unless requested.

## Free Resource
- **3 Quick Fixes to Climb Google Maps:** https://sinchi.co.nz/3-quick-fixes
- **1.** Get categories right (align primary category with real search terms).
- **2.** Build weekly review velocity and reply with natural trade & suburb keywords.
- **3.** Align website NAP and inject LocalBusiness schema.
